edges.reason: _msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
Constructor uses msg.sender as the initial balance holder and entity.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
transfer uses msg.sender as the source of funds.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as spender for allowance deduction.
withdrawOperationFund authorizes through the onlyOwner modifier comparing owner() to msg.sender.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership writes _owner to address(0).
transferOwnership reads and overwrites the privileged _owner variable.
totalSupply returns _total.
balanceOf reads _balance[account].
transfer reads balances through the _transfer call.
transferFrom reads balances through the _transfer call.
burnToken reads and subtracts from _balance[address(this)].
_transfer reads and writes the _balance mapping.
allowance returns _allowances[owner][spender].
transferFrom reads and decrements _allowances.
increaseAllowance adds to _allowances.
decreaseAllowance subtracts from _allowances.
burnToken reduces the _total supply.
_transfer enforces maxTxAmount for non-owner transfers.
_transfer uses minHoldingThreshold to add or remove entities.
_transfer compares contract balance against numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity.
_transfer checks inSwapAndLiquify before triggering liquidity.
swapAndLiquify is guarded by lockTheSwap toggling inSwapAndLiquify.
_transfer checks swapAndLiquifyEnabled before swapping.
setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled writes the swapAndLiquifyEnabled flag.
_transfer excludes transfers from uniswapV2Pair from triggering swaps.
swapTokensForEth invokes the stored router instance.
addLiquidity invokes the stored router instance.
Constructor assigns the immutable router.
Constructor assigns the immutable pair created by the factory.
getCommunityIslandFund sums sandFund.
getCommunityIslandFund sums burnableFund.
getCommunityIslandFund sums operationalFund.
startSand splits sandFund into prize tiers.
payoutLargeRedistribution decrements sandFund by the grand prize.
payoutMediumRedistribution decrements sandFund by total disbursed.
payoutSmallRedistribution decrements sandFund by total disbursed.
startSand snapshots lastIndexUsed into lastEntryAllowed.
addEntity increments lastIndexUsed.
removeEntity decrements lastIndexUsed and moves the last entity.
shuffleEntities derives indices modulo lastIndexUsed - 1.
payoutLargeRedistribution bounds randomness by lastEntryAllowed.
payoutMediumRedistribution branches on lastEntryAllowed and uses it as modulus.
payoutSmallRedistribution divides by lastEntryAllowed and stops at it.
EndSand resets lastEntryAllowed to zero.
payoutSmallRedistribution iterates up to startIndex + perBatchSize.
setBatchSize writes perBatchSize.
payoutMediumRedistribution reads indexToEntity to pick winners.
payoutSmallRedistribution reads indexToEntity to pay rewards.
getEntity returns the stored Entity struct.
shuffleEntities swaps Entity entries between indices.
removeEntity overwrites the removed slot with the last entity.
addEntity writes a new Entity at the next index.
getEntityTimeStamp resolves the wallet index through addressToIndex.
addEntity records addressToIndex for the wallet.
removeEntity clears and rewrites addressToIndex entries.
_extractSandFund uses the sandTax rate.
_extractBurnableFund uses the burnableFundRate.
_extractOperationalFund uses the operationalFundRate.
burnToken requires amount <= burnableFund and decrements it.
withdrawOperationFund decrements operationalFund.
addEntity stores block.timestamp as entity creation time, making state miner-dependent.
payoutLargeRedistribution seeds randomness with block.timestamp plus msg.sender.
payoutMediumRedistribution seeds randomness with block.timestamp plus msg.sender.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the swap deadline.
addLiquidity passes block.timestamp as the liquidity deadline.
Constructor performs an external createPair call on the Uniswap factory.
transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the allowance.
approve delegates to _approve.
increaseAllowance delegates to _approve.
decreaseAllowance delegates to _approve.
_transfer triggers swapAndLiquify when the contract balance exceeds the threshold.
_transfer computes the net amount through _getValues.
_transfer registers the recipient as an entity when above the threshold.
_transfer removes the sender entity when below the threshold.
_transfer shuffles entities using the transfer amounts.
_getValues extracts the sand fund contribution.
_getValues extracts the operational fund contribution.
_getValues extracts the burnable fund contribution.
_extractSandFund computes the contribution via _getExtractableFund.
_extractOperationalFund computes the contribution via _getExtractableFund.
_extractBurnableFund computes the contribution via _getExtractableFund.
_getValues performs unchecked-by-design fund arithmetic (mul/div by rate and subtraction of taxes).
_extractBurnableFund accumulates burnableFund through arithmetic addition.
_extractSandFund accumulates sandFund through arithmetic addition.
burnToken subtracts from _balance, _total and burnableFund.
withdrawOperationFund adjusts operationalFund and balances arithmetically.
swapAndLiquify swaps half of the tokens for ETH.
swapAndLiquify adds the remaining tokens and received ETH as liquidity.
swapTokensForEth executes an external router call that transfers control to Uniswap.
addLiquidity executes a payable external call to the router with ETH value.
payoutLargeRedistribution fetches the candidate entity through getEntity.
payoutLargeRedistribution derives the winner index from timestamp-bound randomness.
payoutMediumRedistribution derives eligible indices from timestamp-bound randomness.
payoutLargeRedistribution resets mediumPrizeTotal indirectly after paying the grand prize.
payoutMediumRedistribution resets smallPrizeTotal usage boundaries.
payoutSmallRedistribution reads and clears smallPrizeTotal.
EndSand zeroes largePrizeTotal.
EndSand zeroes mediumPrizeTotal.
EndSand zeroes smallPrizeTotal.

The router swap returns ETH to the contract, invoking the receive hook.
During the external swap call control leaves the contract and could re-enter _transfer before state is settled.
swapAndLiquify lockTheSwap modifier sets and clears inSwapAndLiquify around the external calls.

normalization_plan.reason: The burn amount parameter only exists to serve burnToken's privileged burn logic.
The recipient wallet parameter is only consumed by withdrawOperationFund's fund transfer.
The startIndex parameter only controls the payoutSmallRedistribution batch loop.
The newOwner parameter is only consumed by transferOwnership's ownership assignment.
The enabled flag only drives the setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled state update.
randNum is a temporary index local to payoutLargeRedistribution's winner selection.
randNum is a temporary index local to payoutMediumRedistribution's eligible selection.
contractTokenBalance is a temporary accounting local computed inside _transfer.
transactionTokenAmount is the recipient credit local produced inside _transfer.
seed is a loop-local entropy counter inside payoutLargeRedistribution.
counter tracks medium prize disbursement inside payoutMediumRedistribution's loop.
